name: Inheritance
description: Inheritance model(s) applied for variant filtering (e.g. dominant, recessive, de novo)

name: Custom_Allele_Counts
description: Custom allele counts

name: PanelApp_Genes
description: Restrict analysis to genes defined in selected PanelApp lists

name: Custom_Genes
description: User-defined list of genes to include in filtering
example_value: SHOX2; SNTA1; SOD2; TCAP; TGFB3; TTL; UQCRFS1

name: Treat_Negative
description: Reverse the filtering logic and exclude any variants in the genes lists selected by the user.

name: Inheritance_PanelApp_Gene
description: Apply selected mode of inheritance to PanelApp genes

name: Substract_PanelApp_Gene_Lists
description: PanelApp gene lists to be subtracted from the analysis
example_value: Achromatopsia;Alternating Hemiplegia and Hemiplegic Migraine;Bardet Biedl syndrome

name: Substract_PanelApp_Genes
description: Individual PanelApp genes to exclude
example_value: SLC4A4; TBX20; TBX5; TNNI3K; TRIM63; VCL

name: HPO_Terms
description: Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms used for phenotype-driven prioritisation (annotation only, not used for filtering).

name: SNV_Annotation
description: VEP functional annotation categories used for SNVs/Indels filtering

name: SNV_Pathogenicity
description: ClinVar pathogenicity classification for SNVs/Indels

name: SNV_SpliceAI_score
description: Minimum SpliceAI score required for splice-impact SNVs/Indels

name: SNV_gnomADv4_AF
description: Maximum allowed gnomAD v4 allele frequency for SNVs/Indels

name: SNV_Affected_only
description: Only apply quality filters for SNVs/Indels present in affected individuals for filtering

name: SNV_Genotype_quality
description: Minimum genotype quality (GQ) threshold for SNVs/Indels

name: SNV_Allele_balance
description: Minimum allele balance required for heterozygous SNVs/Indels

name: SNV_Min_read_depth
description: Minimum read depth threshold

name: SNV_REVEL
description: REVEL ensemble missense pathogenicity score.

name: SNV_AlphaMissense
description: AlphaMissense score

name: SNV_SIFT
description: SIFT prediction

name: SNV_PolyPhen
description: PolyPhen-2 prediction

name: SNV_Use_AF
description: Use SNV_gnomADv4_AF for clinvar and spliceAI override filters

name: SV_Annotation
description: VEP functional or genomic annotation categories used for SV filtering

name: SV_gnomADv4_AF
description: Maximum allowed gnomAD v4 allele frequency for SVs derived from SVlog.

name: SV_Affected_only
description: Only apply quality filters for SVs present in affected individuals

name: SV_Genotype_quality
description: Minimum genotype quality (GQ) threshold for SVs

name: SV_Allele_balance
description: Minimum allele balance required for heterozygous SVs

name: SV_Min_read_depth
description: Minimum read depth threshold

name: SV_SV_type
description: Structural variant types to include (e.g. DEL, DUP, INV, INS)

name: SV_Min_SV_Length
description: Minimum SV length (bp) to retain

name: SV_Max_SV_Length
description: Maximum SV length (bp) to retain

name: SV_Pathogenicity
description: ClinVar pathogenicity classification for SVs derived from SVlog.

name: SV_SVlog_Annotation
description: SV annotation categories derived from SVlog

name: SV_SVlog_min_recip_overlap
description: Minimum reciprocal overlap required for SVlog matches (applicable to DEL, INV, DUP)

name: SV_SVlog_max_break_distance
description: Maximum breakpoint distance allowed for SVlog matching (applicable to INS)

name: SV_SVlog_max_abs_dlen
description: Maximum absolute difference in SV length for SVlog matching (applicable to INS)

name: SV_SVlog_internal_max_carriers
description: Maximum number of internal cohort carriers allowed

name: SV_SVlog_internal_max_families
description: Maximum number of internal families carrying the SV

name: SV_SVlog_1000G_max_carriers
description: Maximum number of carriers allowed in 1000 Genomes

name: SV_SVlog_Advanced_Keeping
description: SVlog predicates selected for explicitly keeping variants

name: SV_SVlog_Advanced_Filtering_out
description: SVlog predicates selected for explicitly filtering out variants

name: SV_Keeping
description: Keeping tier (0–3) based on SVlog match strength (identical → equivalent → related)

name: SV_Filtering_out
description: Filtering out tier (1–3) based on SVlog match strength (identical → equivalent → related)

name: SV_intronic_splice_max_dist
description: Maximum distance from splice junction for intronic SVs

name: SV_intronic_min_len_intron_ratio
description: Minimum SV length relative to intron length

name: SV_tad_max_dist
description: Maximum distance to topologically associating domain (TAD) boundary

name: SV_enhancer_max_dist
description: Maximum distance to annotated enhancer regions

name: SV_intra_tad_only
description: Restrict SVs to those occurring within a single TAD

name: SV_inter_tad_only
description: Restrict SVs to those spanning multiple TADs

name: SV_SVscanner_classification
description: SVScanner classification categories to include

name: SV_SVscanner_reciprocal
description: Mobile-element extent category from SVScanner: full (likely full transposition element) or partial (likely truncated/partial element)
